LESSON: SIMILARITY AND ENLARGEMENT

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry 4.2 Scale Drawing (14 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the learne
Topic 4.3: Similarity and Enlargement
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Similarity and Enlargement, part of Geometry 4.2 Scale Drawing (14 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the learne in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use enlargement in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Collect objects and sort according to similarity. Discuss and note down properties of similar objects in purposive groups. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to collect objects and sort. More time could be allowed for learners with speech difficulties to express their views.

2. Use properties of similar objects to scale-draw similar figures.

3. Discuss in purposive groups/pairs and identify properties of enlargement.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Collect objects and sort according to similarity. Discuss and note down properties of similar objects in purposive groups. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to collect objects and sort. More time could be allowed for learners with speech difficulties to express their views.
2. Use properties of similar objects to scale-draw similar figures.
3. Discuss in purposive groups/pairs and identify properties of enlargement.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Similarity and Enlargement together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving - as the learner draws similar and enlarged objects and figures.

● Digital literacy - as the learner learns and uses digital devices to enlarge objects and figures.

Values:
● Responsibility - as the learner collects similar objects and take care of them in the learning process.

● Social cohesion - as the learner works in groups to draw similar objects and figures.

53

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental Education -as the learner collects similar objects from the environment.

Link to other subjects:

Pre-Technical Studies contributes to learner’s scale-drawing skills of similar figures and objects.
